reviews.summary: The formula lead (one detail from this year, one plan for next), specific plain lines and the what-to-leave-out list beat the bulk lists; the corrected Letter card sells nothing it does not give. Polish: say earlier that photos are paid.

Free note (500 characters and a song), Make it special, the seal and polaroids, Snow Globe and Fireside all checked against the code; "a longer letter" matches faqFreeAShort; Spanish matches sentence for sentence. Polish: reorder "photos, falling in as polaroids," so it does not read as a list; /pricing FAQ still describes the old free tier: a site issue already in the backlog for a person, not counted against the post.

Against 120-150 line lists (American Greetings, scoopwhoop, swifdoo, AOL), the personal-touch section, long-distance lines and the letter section cover every intent on page one, and the refreshed card is accurate in both languages.

applied: Letter card: free as a short note of up to 500 characters and a song; photos and a longer letter with Make it special, paid once, linked to /pricing; Spanish to match; updated 2026-11-24
rejected: Polish left for later: the panel passed this version
